failure_modes: HTTP exposes raw SDK diagnostics, hashes, IDs, credentials, HTML or mutable configuration
Media/table SDK values lose content or numeric image widths are rejected
Entry-only listing excludes successfully discovered deep resources
Unchanged or failed latest observation replaces the successful immutable Version
Source entry lookup performs network access, ignores normalization, or combines same-host entries
Unknown/empty/ambiguous source and invalid parameters collapse to success or wrong status
Pagination truncates, duplicates, skips or changes historical content during commits
Snapshot cursor leaks internals, refreshes lifetime, accepts other caller/source or tampering
Authorization occurs after SQL/S3 access or allows anonymous/wildcard/cross-source access
Attachments use webpage links rather than external archived attachment_refs
Attachment token can be tampered, reused for wrong source/version or outlive contract
Attachment bytes/headers/base URL are unsafe or old valid attachment disappears after new Version
Missing/hash-corrupt/invalid JSON/envelope/whitelist types silently skip rows
Unavailable SQL/S3, slow body, saturation or oversized objects/pages hang or allocate unbounded work
Serve initializes/writes DB, object storage, crawler state or materializes archive copies
Errors or command receipts leak keys, token IDs, connection secrets, paths or stack traces
boundary_inputs: Empty arrays/null scalar/missing markdown; SDK image numeric width; nonempty table/video/audio
Two same-host distinct entries; source-only empty and duplicate registered entry
More than100 current versions; updates/new first success before and after page2
Caller with all sources, caller with subset, alternate caller with same source
Signed but expired authentic tokens; malformed/tampered/cross-purpose tokens
Existing object removed, corrupted at same SHA key, valid SHA JSON with invalid typed fields
Small configured result/attachment/page limits; slow full S3 response and workers=1 saturation
isolation: Fresh loopback-only containers, random credentials, synthetic registered sources; root minio never inspected
